name: Validate Google Sheets email addresses with ZeroBounce

parameters.content:
## Google Sheets email validation
Connect Google Sheets OAuth2 to the read node. Connect HTTP Query Auth to ZeroBounce with parameter name api_key; keep the value inside n8n Credentials.

Set spreadsheet ID, a bounded range beginning with an email header, and a maximum of 100 unique addresses. Blank rows are skipped and duplicates are validated once.

ZeroBounce requires credits. This produces a report, does not send messages or change the sheet, and does not establish consent. See the guide.
